rubrics.justification: Generally reasonable and appropriately caveated, but it overcalls the image as clearly compatible with a good 3AA expanded blastocyst; the static image shows a blastocyst with visible cavity and probable ICM, but TE cohesion and true AA quality are not convincingly demonstrable from this frame.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, diagnosis, prior miscarriage, sperm factors, endometrium, and lifestyle with embryo quality and prognosis.
The reasoning is structured and internally consistent, with appropriate acknowledgment that morphology does not determine ploidy; only minor overinterpretation of image quality/prognosis.

Recommendations are largely consistent with IVF practice guidelines: SET for a good Day 5 blastocyst in a 33-year-old, smoking cessation, luteal support, and selective rather than routine PGT-A. Minor speculative points about FET superiority and trigger adjustment are less firmly case-driven.
Provides clear practical next steps for transfer management and contingency planning, though some suggestions remain somewhat general rather than tightly tailored to this exact cycle.
